title: Deepen architecture principles and data authority docs
description: Expand architecture docs with runtime layers, request lifecycle, data authority, current-vs-historical boundaries, and troubleshooting details.
action: Modify docs-site/src/client/data/content-architecture.ts so system-overview, module-design, and data-flow include sections named '运行时边界', '请求生命周期', '数据权威顺序', and '历史架构边界'. Include Mermaid diagrams for runtime layer and sequence lifecycle.

convergence.definition_of_done: Architecture pages explain how Niko Studio works and where current authority boundaries are.

files.change: Add architecture principle sections and diagrams.

implementation: In system-overview, add '运行时边界' explaining Tauri host, React frontend, Gateway, intelligence modules, storage, and model providers.
In data-flow, add '请求生命周期' sequenceDiagram for UI -> Gateway -> context -> model/rules -> structured result.
Add '数据权威顺序' table: Raw evidence/author decisions, Wiki/canon, writer-facing surfaces, graph/memory projections, chat answers.
Add '历史架构边界' note that historical/browser-first/Python docs are references unless current README/CAPABILITY_MATRIX says shipped.

rationale.chosen_approach: Extending existing architecture pages avoids unnecessary navigation churn while deepening principles.
rationale.tradeoffs: Longer pages require strong headings and tables.

risks: May overstate historical features if source-of-truth wording is ignored.
